Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly shifted the target from the correct choice (coal-burning factories, option C) to hydroelectric power plants (option B), instructing validation of reservoir-induced acidity and stating the goal was to underpin option B. This misalignment with established science about acid rain (from SO2/NOx, largely from coal burning) led the process toward the wrong answer and caused repetitive, unfocused searches.
